texts.orig: Good Gradings of Generalized Incidence Rings
texts.text: Good Gradings of Generalized Incidence Rings

texts.label: text
texts.orig: This inquiry is based on both the construction of generalized incidence rings due to Gene Abrams and the construction of good group gradings of incidence algebras due to Molli Jones. We provide conditions for a generalized incidence ring to be graded isomorphic to a subring of an incidence ring over a preorder. We also extend Jones's construction to good group gradings for incidence algebras over preorders with crosscuts of length one or two.
